name: Aikawa Chiharu
source: A freshman this year and is the boxing club's new manager after Shouko. Her great interest in boxing led her to study extra hard so she could enter Ryouzuki school, a place famous of its boxing club. She's polite and has a very bright personality. An energetic and careless girl who works with a smile to support the boxing club.
